concerns.text: FR-003 states the system MUST implement a prefrontal gating module that modulates narrative element selection based on coherence constraints, but provides no measurable or observable criterion (e.g., a quantitative coherence metric, a testable API contract, or a validation procedure). Without such a definition the requirement cannot be deterministically verified.

SC-002 describes measuring peak memory usage against the "available RAM limit of the GitHub Actions runner" but does not specify the numeric limit (e.g., ≤ 2 GB). Without an explicit threshold the success criterion is not objectively measurable.
